When the file is served, the browser expands the entity, executing the script. This vulnerability can be exploited by authenticated administrators or, in specific configurations, by guests.
11274fa0f49ffc94:2774.one_liner: NukeViet CMS is vulnerable to stored XSS via malicious SVG uploads that bypass sanitization through DTD entities.
11274fa0f49ffc94:2774.bottom_line: Administrators of NukeViet CMS must update to version 4.5.12 or 4.6.02 to prevent stored XSS attacks via SVG uploads.

5eca248851d8d9b7:1872.summary: Researchers have introduced COTEX, a continual tool-space extension learning framework designed to allow multimodal agents to incorporate new specialist tools without losing proficiency in existing ones. The framework uses adapter-level parameter updates and orthogonal constraints to ensure that new tool-use reasoning trajectories do not interfere with previous capabilities. Experiments across ten vision-language benchmarks demonstrate that COTEX successfully integrates new tools with minimal performance degradation on existing ones. This approach facilitates the scalable expansion of agentic capabilities.
5eca248851d8d9b7:1872.one_liner: COTEX enables multimodal AI agents to learn new tools continuously while maintaining performance on existing ones.
5eca248851d8d9b7:1872.bottom_line: The COTEX framework provides a scalable method for adding specialist tools to multimodal agents without the need for full retraining.

claims.text: COTEX adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost.
claims.support_span: This work proposes COTEX, continual tool-space extension learning, that adds new tools at efficient adapter-level cost.

claims.text: Experiments show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.
claims.support_span: Experiments on two representative agents and three specialist tools show gains on ten vision-language benchmarks, with at most a 0.3-point drop on existing tools.

0c78b4331f903107:8246.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant have reported that hackers are increasingly using AI agents to automate entire stages of cyberattacks, including exploit development and deployment. In some instances, these agents can turn a newly released software patch into a working exploit without human intervention. Security tools like the open-source ARTEX framework are being weaponized by threat actors to conduct multi-target operations at machine speed. This shift poses a significant challenge for defenders, as the speed of automated attacks now outpaces traditional human-led response times.
0c78b4331f903107:8246.one_liner: Hackers are weaponizing AI agents to automate the entire attack lifecycle, from patch analysis to exploit deployment.
0c78b4331f903107:8246.bottom_line: The rise of autonomous AI-driven attack pipelines means that software vulnerabilities can now be exploited at machine speed, leaving little time for human-led patching and defense.

a8b5b88e7d4bd1ad:2252.summary: Researchers have proposed a Behavioral Integrity Verification (BIV) framework to audit AI agent skills, which often have privileged access to filesystems, credentials, and network calls. The framework compares declared capabilities against actual implementation using deterministic code analysis and LLM-assisted extraction. Analysis of 49,943 skills from the OpenClaw registry revealed that 80% of skills contain at least one deviation between description and implementation, though most are due to developer oversight rather than malice. The BIV framework achieved an F1 score of 0.949 in detecting malicious skills.
a8b5b88e7d4bd1ad:2252.one_liner: The BIV framework provides a scalable way to audit AI agent skills for security deviations and malicious intent.
a8b5b88e7d4bd1ad:2252.bottom_line: Most AI agent skills exhibit discrepancies between their stated and actual capabilities, highlighting the need for automated behavioral integrity auditing.

claims.text: The BIV framework compares declared and actual capabilities over a shared taxonomy.
claims.support_span: We formalize this as the behavioral integrity verification (BIV) problem: a typed set comparison between declared and actual capabilities over a shared taxonomy that bridges code, instructions, and metadata.

claims.text: 80.0% of skills have at least one deviation in the taxonomy.
claims.support_span: 80.0% of skills have at least one deviation in the taxonomy, with four compound-threat categories surfaced.

cb88a6ce330fb784:2532.summary: NukeViet CMS versions prior to 4.5.09 are vulnerable to an arbitrary file deletion vulnerability via the Edit Comment function. An authenticated administrator can submit a crafted attachment value that includes a traversal path, which is then stored in the database. When the comment is deleted, the system joins this path to the upload directory and passes it to a file deletion function that fails to properly restrict the scope, allowing the deletion of critical application files like config.php. This vulnerability can lead to a complete application outage.
cb88a6ce330fb784:2532.one_liner: NukeViet CMS is vulnerable to arbitrary file deletion via a path traversal flaw in the Edit Comment function.
cb88a6ce330fb784:2532.bottom_line: Administrators must update NukeViet CMS to version 4.5.09 to prevent an authenticated attacker from deleting critical system files.

claims.support_span: This issue is fixed in version 4.5.09.

1191b82a870c6f74:1850.summary: Researchers have introduced 'automodel', an agent skill designed to automate the discovery and improvement of scientific models. By providing general-purpose coding agents with a model discovery recipe, the tool enables the identification of novel models in fields such as astrophysics, cardiovascular dynamics, and precision agriculture. Case studies demonstrate that this approach is a powerful, interactive, and portable alternative to domain-specific automated discovery pipelines. The skill is available for integration into existing agentic systems.
1191b82a870c6f74:1850.one_liner: The 'automodel' agent skill automates scientific model discovery, offering a portable alternative to specialized pipelines.
1191b82a870c6f74:1850.bottom_line: Encoding model-discovery methodology as a portable agent skill allows general-purpose AI agents to successfully identify novel scientific models across diverse domains.

c9d0b4f2d81b8141:2265.summary: The devpi-web application before version 5.2.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in its +doc route. The flaw exists because the docs_file_exists and docs_file_path functions fail to properly restrict file paths to the intended documentation directory. Attackers can exploit this by using leading slashes or percent-encoded directory traversal sequences to read arbitrary files on the server, including sensitive data like the keyfs SQLite database containing password hashes.
c9d0b4f2d81b8141:2265.one_liner: A critical path traversal vulnerability in devpi-web allows unauthenticated attackers to read sensitive server files, including credential databases.
c9d0b4f2d81b8141:2265.bottom_line: If you are running devpi-web, you must upgrade to version 5.2.0 or later immediately to prevent unauthorized access to your server's filesystem and credential stores.

claims.text: devpi-web before 5.2.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the +doc documentation route because docs_file_exists and docs_file_path in doczip.py never confine relpath to the documentation directory.
claims.support_span: devpi-web before 5.2.0 contains an unauthenticated path traversal vulnerability in the +doc documentation route because docs_file_exists and docs_file_path in doczip.py never confine relpath to the documentation directory.

claims.text: Attackers can request a relpath with a leading // or percent-encoded .. segments to read server files, including the keyfs sqlite database holding password hashes.
claims.support_span: Attackers can request a relpath with a leading // or percent-encoded .. segments to read server files, including the keyfs sqlite database holding password hashes.

key_facts: Impact: Arbitrary file read including password databases

7084b4f0a7e7899b:935.summary: A high-severity vulnerability (CVSS 8.3) exists in Nordic Semiconductor's nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.1. The issue occurs in the Aliro access control reference application when specific trust configurations are enabled, causing the system to incorrectly treat a failed credential issuer lookup as a success. This allows a former authorized user with an old, correctly signed Access Document to bypass revocation and gain physical access even after the issuer has revoked the credential.
7084b4f0a7e7899b:935.one_liner: A flaw in Nordic Semiconductor's Aliro implementation allows revoked credentials to remain valid, enabling unauthorized physical access.
7084b4f0a7e7899b:935.bottom_line: Organizations using Nordic Semiconductor's nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on must update to version 1.2.0 to ensure credential revocation is correctly enforced.

claims.text: In the Aliro access control reference applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0 through v1.1.1... AccessManagerImpl::ProcessValidityIteration() treats a failed lookup of the Credential Issuer in the provisioned issuer array as success.
claims.support_span: In the Aliro access control reference applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0 through v1.1.1, built with Credential Issuer CA certificate-based issuer trust (CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_CREDENTIAL_ISSUER_CA) and the Aliro Step-up phase (CONFIG_DOOR_LOCK_STEP_UP_PHASE) enabled, AccessManagerImpl::ProcessValidityIteration() treats a failed lookup of the Credential Issuer in the provisioned issuer array as success.

claims.text: A former authorized holder with an old but correctly issuer-signed Access Document can be granted physical access after the issuer has advanced its iteration to revoke that credential.
claims.support_span: A former authorized holder with an old but correctly issuer-signed Access Document can be granted physical access after the issuer has advanced its iteration to revoke that credential.

key_facts: Affected: Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on v1.0.0-v1.1.1

d93081553b9b4583:2770.summary: SPILLWAY is a new defense mechanism designed to protect tool-using AI agents from prompt injection attacks. Unlike traditional methods that rely on LLMs to plan or route tasks, SPILLWAY uses a deterministic approach to separate target admission from sanitization. It ensures that any target value in a tool's output that was not in the user's original task must come from a read-only tool or a predefined delegation rule, effectively preventing attackers from redirecting agent actions.
d93081553b9b4583:2770.one_liner: SPILLWAY provides a deterministic, low-overhead defense against prompt injection for AI agents by strictly validating action targets.
d93081553b9b4583:2770.bottom_line: Developers building AI agents that interact with sensitive systems like email or payments should adopt SPILLWAY's deterministic target validation to prevent unauthorized action redirection.

claims.text: SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic floor with no per-task plan.
claims.support_span: SPILLWAY turns this observation into a deterministic floor with no per-task plan.

claims.text: The check admits a call when each target value that appears in tool output but not in the user's task was returned by a read-only tool in a typed field or is covered by a fixed delegation rule.
claims.support_span: The check admits a call when each target value that appears in tool output but not in the user's task was returned by a read-only tool in a typed field or is covered by a fixed delegation rule.

70127455e8b4aefd:2046.summary: Researchers have developed 'Closure,' a wallet-side security tool designed to prevent unauthorized transactions in agent-based commerce. The study identifies that current wallet signing processes often fail to account for the full range of transfer sequences enabled by a signed object, leading to potential security gaps. By implementing a checker that evaluates 13 families of signed objects, the researchers successfully rejected all malicious objects in their test model while maintaining high performance, with a median decision time of 12 microseconds.
70127455e8b4aefd:2046.one_liner: New 'Closure' tool prevents AI agents from executing unauthorized transactions by validating the full scope of wallet-signed objects.
70127455e8b4aefd:2046.bottom_line: Wallet developers should integrate 'Closure'-style validation to ensure that signed objects cannot be exploited to perform actions outside the user's original intent.

claims.text: We define authority closure as the set of transfer sequences that holding the signed object can enable.
claims.support_span: We define authority closure as the set of transfer sequences that holding the signed object can enable.

claims.text: In an evaluation of 2,130 generated objects and 62,979 execution programs, 265 objects with an observed violation passed both a field-and-expiry check and an address allow-list.
claims.support_span: In an evaluation of 2,130 generated objects and 62,979 execution programs, 265 objects with an observed violation passed both a field-and-expiry check and an address allow-list.

663a73514a9face9:6029.summary: A critical vulnerability in the Linux kernel's KVM hypervisor, CVE-2026-99312, allows a guest virtual machine to read host memory on AMD-based systems with nested virtualization enabled. The flaw stems from a failure to properly reset memory pointers during a nested VM reset, potentially exposing up to 127 GB of host RAM to an attacker with root access inside a guest. While the Linux kernel team assigned a CVSS score of 8.8, some vendors have rated it lower, focusing on denial-of-service impacts. Patches have been merged upstream, and cloud providers are deploying fixes to secure their infrastructure.
663a73514a9face9:6029.one_liner: If you run KVM on AMD hardware with nested virtualization, you are vulnerable to host memory exposure and must update your kernel immediately.
663a73514a9face9:6029.bottom_line: A critical memory-leak vulnerability in KVM on AMD hosts allows guest-to-host memory access, necessitating an immediate kernel update or the disabling of nested virtualization.

claims.support_span: The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled.

eade1d1b0c9cee7b:2799.summary: LibreChat versions 0.7.0 through 0.8.6 contain a pre-registration account takeover vulnerability, CVE-2026-54039. An unauthenticated attacker can manipulate the registration API to associate a victim's email address with an attacker-controlled provider, allowing the attacker to hijack the victim's account when they attempt to sign in via social login. This flaw effectively binds the attacker's session to the victim's identity, granting persistent access to the victim's data. The issue has been addressed in version 0.8.6.
eade1d1b0c9cee7b:2799.one_liner: LibreChat users must update to 0.8.6 to prevent an account takeover vulnerability that allows attackers to hijack accounts via social login email fallback.
eade1d1b0c9cee7b:2799.bottom_line: An unauthenticated account takeover vulnerability in LibreChat allows attackers to hijack user accounts by manipulating the registration provider field.

claims.text: From 0.7.0 until 0.8.6, when local registration is enabled and at least one social provider is configured, POST /api/auth/register passes an unparsed request object into api/server/services/AuthService.js, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to persist a forged provider value for a known victim email.
claims.support_span: From 0.7.0 until 0.8.6, when local registration is enabled and at least one social provider is configured, POST /api/auth/register passes an unparsed request object into api/server/services/AuthService.js, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to persist a forged provider value for a known victim email.

claims.support_span: This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

02b022d21d0866f7:2970.summary: The mcp-ssh-manager tool is vulnerable to command injection in its database helper functions, tracked as CVE-2026-77383. Prior to version 3.6.7, the application failed to sanitize user-controlled inputs such as database names and host parameters before passing them to shell-evaluated commands. This allows an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the target SSH server with the privileges of the MCP server account. The vulnerability persists even in restricted security modes for certain functions, and users are advised to upgrade to 3.6.7.

While the primary impact is a process crash, the vulnerability may potentially allow for arbitrary code execution. Users should upgrade to version 8.6.5 to mitigate this risk.

claims.support_span: From 8.2.0 until 8.6.5, an unauthenticated attacker can send a WMS GetLegendGraphic request with a nonempty BBOX and repeated LAYER parameters to trigger a heap buffer overflow in msWMSDispatch() in src/mapwms.cpp.

ad81bcc11764b0b5:2590.summary: Qwik City and Router contain a vulnerability in the formToObj function that allows unauthenticated attackers to perform a Denial of Service (DoS) attack. 571da629935d3405:2467.summary: This research introduces a theory of software thermodynamics to analyze the efficiency and cost of agentic coding. The study suggests that this thermodynamic lens could lead to new tools for optimizing coding agents and reducing the high token costs associated with current agentic workflows.

c0ed4e9a415ab6a0:2241.summary: Large vision-language models and language models often exhibit attention sinks where tokens like the beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token receive disproportionate attention, but standard causal masking prevents the BOS query from carrying input context. Across multiple model families and eight benchmarks, BOS Summary improves reasoning performance and weakens sink dominance by redistributing attention to content-bearing prompt tokens.

3b1f2aad28f221e2:17264.summary: A new security tool called 'ABA' (A Better Antivirus) acts as a tripwire to detect infostealers by planting fake, attractive data—such as passwords, wallets, and app tokens—in locations typically targeted by malware. Unlike traditional antivirus software that focuses on preventing execution, ABA is designed to catch stealers that have already bypassed initial defenses. bf85c050a9e1a948:2689.summary: The ChainIT Authority Protocol provides a subject-neutral and rail-neutral pre-execution authority and evidence control plane for human, organizational, and agentic transactions. 6dda97006bce3862:2451.bottom_line: Current VLM agents achieve a fraction of human radiologist accuracy on emergency imaging and fail to correct early misdiagnoses.

472fdf736744158f:2314.summary: GDDR memory in modern graphics processing units remains vulnerable to Rowhammer attacks, where rapid memory access induces bit flips to bypass security boundaries. Previous GPU attacks suffered from low hammering intensity due to uniform activation patterns that treated aggressor and decoy rows equally. Researchers developed GPUThor, an attack framework that reverse-engineers memory-access coalescing and tracks refresh cycles to implement non-uniform hammering patterns. This technique yields up to 23,500 times more bit flips than prior methods and enables the first successful Rowhammer exploits on ECC-protected GPUs by inducing uncorrectable double and triple bit flips.

472fdf736744158f:2314.bottom_line: ECC protection on modern GPUs can be bypassed using non-uniform Rowhammer patterns that induce uncorrectable double and triple bit flips.

claims.support_span: We present GPUThor, a high-intensity Rowhammer attack on NVIDIA GPUs leveraging non-uniform hammering.

claims.text: GPUThor also enables the first Rowhammer exploits on ECC-protected GPUs, inducing uncorrectable double and triple bit flips, making denial-of-service and privilege-escalation attacks practical even on GPUs with ECC enabled.

1df53018af16af50:12880.summary: Microsoft's agent-framework meta-package on PyPI was compromised in versions 1.26.1 and 1.26.2, deploying a credential-stealing startup hook that ran every time Python started. Elastic Security Labs flagged the package six minutes after publication, and PyPI removed both versions within an hour. Anyone who used those versions on a host should assume all secrets on that host are compromised and pin back to version 1.26.0.

7f291194c90d20b7:6890.summary: Digital evidence now contributes to approximately 90 percent of criminal cases, transforming investigations across devices like smartphones, laptops, and cloud accounts. Standard forensic procedures require isolating seized devices from networks to prevent remote wiping, creating exact forensic images, and validating data integrity using cryptographic hash values with strict chain-of-custody logging. While forensic tools extract extensive logs, messages, and location records, analysts must account for limitations such as device encryption, cloud-only data storage, and potential inaccuracy in cell tower positioning. Defense strategies routinely rely on third-party experts to verify hash values, timezone settings, and the reliability of automated tool outputs.

223aaaa4b16960d8:785.summary: A path traversal vulnerability exists in ansible-core during the collection installation process via ansible-galaxy collection install. Because namespace and name fields inside collection artifact metadata are unvalidated for path containment, a malicious collection artifact delivered via local files, URLs, source directories, git repositories, or dependencies can redirect the destination outside the configured path. 3b1f2aad28f221e2:20218.summary: The 'A Better Antivirus' (ABA) project is a security tool designed to detect and freeze infostealers by planting 'bait' files—such as fake passwords, wallets, and app data—that only malicious software would attempt to access. When a process interacts with these baits, ABA immediately freezes the process and, on Linux, isolates its network traffic using nftables. The tool is intended to complement, not replace, traditional antivirus software like Windows Defender by acting as a tripwire for threats that have already bypassed signature-based detection. It supports both Windows and Linux, with the Linux version leveraging kernel-level monitoring via fanotify.

It is used in authentication protocols, to encode file uploads, and to deliver network messages,” the company explained. “To decode Base64 faster, OpenJDK uses specialized x86-64 CPU instructions to process many bytes at once.” “We discovered a bug in that optimized machine-level code that lets malformed input overwrite neighboring memory. With careful exploitation, the corruption can reveal sensitive memory, as Heartbleed did, or lead to remote code execution. The corruption itself can be triggered by just 64 A characters followed by a single =:” Calif applied the CVSS 4.0 bug-rating scheme and gave the flaw a critical-rated score of 9.2/10.

fa700a4eb8ceffe8:2978.summary: A newly disclosed unpatched Windows zero-day technique called FastUnlock allows individuals with physical access to a locked Windows PC to run programs without signing in, granting access to a limited user account (WSIAccount) rather than administrator privileges. Discovered by researchers using the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, the technique utilizes Windows' built-in Narrator screen reader to navigate the lock screen via a reachable Microsoft account through recovery options. Because many systems use BitLocker with TPM chips to automatically unlock drives at startup, the file system is already readable when the lock screen appears, meaning FastUnlock does not break disk encryption. Microsoft has not yet issued a fix, so users are advised to secure physical access, use startup PINs for BitLocker, and hibernate devices when unattended.
fa700a4eb8ceffe8:2978.one_liner: FastUnlock is an unpatched Windows zero-day technique allowing limited program execution from the lock screen via Narrator.

19b09b299a8e66a5:5074.summary: A security discussion on the oss-security mailing list highlights that aiohttp's CVE-2025-69224 header hardening fix from January 2026 was only applied to the request parser and not the response parser. 137eb70e93d94822:16781.summary: T3 Code, an open-source unified control plane by Ping Labs, has surpassed 65,000 GitHub stars by orchestrating local AI coding CLIs and ACP providers across desktop, web, and mobile clients. The software coordinates multi-agent delegation over MCP and isolates concurrent edits within separate Git worktrees while utilizing native CLI authentication tokens. While this architecture avoids shadow proxies and preserves vendor compliance, it concentrates execution authority inside the local server process, inheriting the host user's shell, filesystem, and token store access. Consequently, development teams adopting the control plane must enforce least-privilege MCP permissions and secure remote access through SSH port forwarding or Tailscale to prevent local privilege escalation and supply-chain exposure.

0bbcb5bea3f3bc47:3862.summary: A VentureBeat pilot test evaluating Anthropic's Claude models found that the flagship Claude Fable 5.2 model cost roughly three times more than its cheaper sibling Opus 5.5 while delivering virtually identical bug-fixing performance. Fable 5.2 fixed 10 out of 15 bugs for approximately $89, whereas Opus 5.5 fixed 9 out of 15 bugs for about $29. 43f917b445109c49:3204.summary: A deserialization vulnerability designated as CVE-2026-124283 affects the ash-project ash framework from version 3.31.3 before 3.38.0. The flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or inject SQL via a forged keyset pagination cursor supplied in Erlang external term format. The vulnerability stems from the framework's failure to examine struct fields within decoded sort expressions, permitting chosen struct modules to reach the data layer and invoke command execution functions. When used with AshPostgres, passing a crafted struct to inspect/1 leads to OS command execution and raw text SQL injection. Remotely exploiting the issue allows attackers to leverage selected struct modules to execute commands.

f80afcc478575741:6029.summary: A vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-99312 in Linux KVM allows guest virtual machines to access host memory on AMD hosts with nested virtualization enabled. Researchers demonstrated reading approximately 127 GB of host RAM and writing chosen bytes into live host kernel memory. The issue stems from KVM failing to restore an outer virtual CPU pointer when an INIT reset signal stops a nested virtual machine, leaving it pointing to freed memory. Upstream Linux kernel maintainers merged a fix, and affected cloud providers and operators must update host kernels or disable nested virtualization. The Linux kernel CVE team rates the flaw 8.8, whereas Red Hat rates it 5.6 as a denial-of-service issue.

e2e760ce3e373007:18818.summary: The second Lexometrica Ground Truth evaluation run on Russian Supreme Court cases demonstrates that AI model rankings are highly sensitive to the choice of the grading judge. When Claude Opus 5.5 grades the 15-model benchmark, it finishes 0.053 points ahead of GPT-6.2 Astra, but when xAI's Grok 4.7 judges instead, Claude falls 0.010 points behind Astra. Tested across 30 legal cases using the IRAC legal analysis framework without search tools, top models like Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon cluster tightly within a narrow 0.09 band. Developer Nikita Polyakov notes that the closed dataset and overlapping confidence intervals mean models can be reliably separated into only five or six distinct quality tiers.

e2e760ce3e373007:18818.bottom_line: AI legal reasoning benchmarks are vulnerable to judge bias, where swapping the grading model can flip top-tier rankings between competing vendors.

90764538b4dfc43c:8842.summary: Sybil Solutions published an open-source inference-optimisation-skill repository in November 2026 with roughly 1,700 GitHub stars to automate LLM serving hill-climbs via agent workflows. The tool targets decode, prefill, speculative decoding, KV cache size, startup, and TTFT across various hardware and quantization limits while incorporating long-context stability gates. To prevent noise-driven performance illusions, it enforces control-candidate interleaving and requires candidates to beat both controls without regressing any core metric by over 3%. ab1fe3bcfe36669d:15773.summary: The Xint research team disclosed the “nginx2root” vulnerability chain, combining five NGINX memory-corruption flaws—anchored by CVE-2026-123007 in NGINX HTTP/2 flow control—with a separate Linux kernel Stream Control Transmission Protocol (SCTP) privilege-escalation bug. Originating in NGINX code paths dating back to HTTP/2 introduction in version 1.9.5, CVE-2026-123007 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker using carefully ordered HTTP/2 frames to leak memory addresses, bypass Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR), and execute code as the NGINX worker process. Chaining that worker foothold with the Linux SCTP vulnerability can escalate privileges to host root, including from inside containerized environments that share the host kernel.

31afdc96e80bb016:4416.summary: A critical, actively exploited vulnerability (CVE-2026-131914) has been identified in the legacy ASP.NET library Idunno.AntiCsrf, which has not been updated since 2008. 89e58371feaf7d8e:8531.summary: AI coding agents frequently execute malicious content encountered during web searches because they lack human skepticism, leading to automated compromise when evaluating top search results. AIR Research Lab's WebSec Benchmark testing across eight search APIs found that every provider served known-malicious content at rates between 0.8% and 2.2% of searches, with package installation and error resolution queries posing the highest risks. Attackers exploit this behavior by publishing high-ranking malicious repositories—such as the SolanaCry malware deployed via PowerShell—or by registering lapsed domains that still appear in developer search queries. This creates an immediate attack vector where autonomous tools execute remote access tools and steal crypto wallets without any user interaction.
89e58371feaf7d8e:8531.one_liner: AI coding agents blindly execute malicious payloads from web search results, with all major search APIs serving known-bad content in benchmark tests.
89e58371feaf7d8e:8531.bottom_line: AI coding agents automatically execute malicious instructions found in search results, turning routine web queries into remote code execution risks.

claims.text: In AIR's tests, all eight search APIs handed them known-malicious content.
claims.support_span: In AIR's tests, all eight search APIs handed them known-malicious content.

claims.text: The WebSec Benchmark, released in November 2026, tested 4,719 searches across eight APIs and found every one served known-malicious content at least once.
claims.support_span: To measure how common this is, AIR Research Lab built the WebSec Benchmark, released in November 2026. The team took 4,719 searches drawn from real coding-agent tasks and sent each one to eight widely used search APIs: Firecrawl, Tavily, Perplexity, Parallel, Exa, Nimble, Brave and You.com. Then they checked all 282,000+ results that came back. Every one of the eight served known-malicious content at least once.

key_facts: Search APIs tested: Firecrawl, Tavily, Perplexity, Parallel, Exa, Nimble, Brave, You.com

de9b57e8dbf97b7c:5598.summary: Preemptive Managed Detection and Response (MDR) connects exposure context, threat intelligence, AI-assisted investigation, and human expertise to help security teams prioritize vulnerabilities before exploitation occurs. d8d6777ecf090783:10463.summary: Researchers optimized inference for the new 26B parameter Inkling 2 Mini open-source model on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96GB GPU using an automated coding agent running experimental optimization skills. By combining vLLM nightly with DSpark speculative decoding and rigorous single-variable benchmarking, single-user decode speed increased by 40% from 136 to 190.6 tokens per second, and 8-user aggregate throughput rose 26% to 716 tokens per second. The winning configuration matches performance seen on higher-end server hardware while preserving long-context needle retrieval up to 250K tokens and byte-identical greedy outputs.

d8d6777ecf090783:10463.bottom_line: Automated agent optimization combined with speculative decoding can lift open-source LLM throughput on consumer-adjacent enterprise hardware like the RTX PRO 6000 by up to 40%.

d291c7256a46aa27:18154.summary: A critical security compromise affecting eMudhra-managed Certificate Authorities was uncovered after a security researcher demonstrated that private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate certificates were fundamentally broken. Administrators are advised to update trust stores and apply vendor patches immediately to mitigate potential exploitation of the compromised certificates.

720ee136746742db:19968.summary: Google Project Zero researcher identified new bypasses for Oracle VirtualBox's process hardening on Windows, specifically focusing on CVE-2026-87268. 6085ef54790f43b5:3883.summary: SHA pinning for GitHub Actions ensures code immutability but fails to guarantee provenance, leaving pipelines vulnerable to malicious fork commits and impostor code. Attackers have successfully exploited this gap by injecting malicious payloads disguised as trusted updates into popular open-source actions like Trivy and actions-cool/issues-helper. While GitHub's newly introduced workflow lockfiles help tie runs to recorded commits on source repositories, they do not verify dependency safety or address runtime build vulnerabilities. Security teams must look beyond pinning to evaluate commit authorship and implement comprehensive provenance checks in their CI/CD pipelines.
6085ef54790f43b5:3883.one_liner: SHA pinning ensures immutability but leaves CI/CD pipelines exposed to impostor commits and fork-based supply chain attacks.
6085ef54790f43b5:3883.bottom_line: SHA pinning guarantees code won't change but fails to verify who wrote it, leaving GitHub Actions vulnerable to malicious fork-based contributions.

claims.text: Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks, but attackers have found a way around it.
claims.support_span: Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks. Attackers have already found a way around it.

cd2598a756bce7d9:2512.summary: CISA has added CVE-2026-131914, a deserialization vulnerability in the legacy Idunno.AntiCsrf library, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. The flaw allows unauthenticated remote code execution by sending a specially crafted HTTP POST request, which the library processes before application logic. Because the project is abandoned, it will not be patched, and security researchers advise replacing it with modern alternatives like ASP.NET Core Anti-Request Forgery. US federal agencies are required to remediate this by November 27.
cd2598a756bce7d9:2512.one_liner: An abandoned ASP.NET anti-CSRF library is being actively exploited for RCE, requiring immediate replacement.
cd2598a756bce7d9:2512.bottom_line: If your legacy ASP.NET applications use Idunno.AntiCsrf, they are vulnerable to RCE and must be refactored to use supported security libraries.

claims.support_span: Disclosed last week by Mandiant and Google Cloud researchers, CVE-2026-131914 can be triggered by sending a specially crafted HTTP POST request, with no prior authentication or valid CSRF token.

c24a380f215ce563:14419.summary: Cisco has disclosed a UEFI Secure Boot bypass vulnerability in its UCS servers and related appliances.
